steps.title: Open System Health
steps.narration: We start on the System Health page, which gathers the forward-tested evidence behind Trendora's rankings.
steps.point_out: The page already shows how each ranked cohort actually performed; the brand-new Return attribution section further down will explain why.

steps.title: Which tickers drove the return
steps.narration: Scrolling down reveals the new Return attribution section. Its first panel names the individual stocks that most drove — or dragged — the cohort's forward return.
steps.point_out: Each named ticker shows its sector, its realized mean return (green for gains, red for losses) and its sample size; the panel beside it opens up the full distribution — mean, median, hit rate and dispersion.

steps.title: By sector and by rank band
steps.narration: The other two panels break the very same return down by sector and by rank band.
steps.point_out: Every configured rank band (1-10, 11-50, 51+) is listed with its own sample size, and higher-ranked bands tend to show stronger returns — you can watch the ranking earn its keep.

steps.title: Switch the holding period
steps.narration: A single horizon selector at the top of the page drives everything at once. We switch it to five trading days.
steps.point_out: There is just one horizon control here — the attribution section rides it rather than introducing a second control.

steps.title: Attribution follows the horizon
steps.narration: The whole section instantly re-reads itself for the 5-day window — the same stored evidence, a different holding period.
steps.point_out: The intro now reads 'Open the 5-day forward return', and the contributors and detractors are re-ranked for that shorter window.

steps.title: Open the Backtest page
steps.narration: The same attribution also lives on the Backtest page, which focuses on a single chosen date.
steps.point_out: One global as-of date governs the page — here it is showing the latest scan and its forward-test scorecard.

steps.title: Honest gaps, never faked
steps.narration: Backtest carries the same four panels, plus its own horizon view selector. At the latest date the forward windows have not elapsed yet.
steps.point_out: Switching horizons here is instant — no reload and the date never changes — and rather than invent a figure, every panel honestly shows a dash with its sample size when no measurable return exists yet.

expect.text: No ticker had a measurable forward return at this horizon.
